extracted.intended_audience: PR- and communications professionals in Germany (agency and in-house communicators, consultants, industry bodies)
extracted.subtask_description: Standards and ethical norms for professional public relations and communications practice in Germany, intended to guide behaviour, decisionmaking and the practical implementation of PR (including online and social media).

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparenz
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of the central norms and target values of the Deutscher Kommunikationskodex: Transparenz.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transparency requires clear disclosure of relationships, funding and the identity of the sender. The 'Tramp a Benz' case is cited: hiding the responsible agency or company violated transparency and led to a DRPR reprimand. Transparent conduct (e.g. visible branding, declared sponsorship) is recommended as it preserves credibility and trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrität
rubrics_metrics.description: Integrität is named as a central norm of the Kodex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrity implies ethical, honest behaviour in communications and adherence to professional norms and international standards rather than opportunistic or deceptive practices. It underpins trustworthiness of the communicator and the profession.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fairness
rubrics_metrics.description: Fairness is listed among the central norms and target values that PR professionals should follow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fairness encompasses equitable treatment of stakeholders, journalists and competitors and functioning as part of professional self-regulation; no detailed scoring guidance on the page, but fairness is presented as a basic ethical expectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wahrhaftigkeit (truthfulness/veracity)
rubrics_metrics.description: Wahrhaftigkeit (truthfulness) appears as a central value in the Kodex and is emphasised in the discussion of professional practice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should aim for truthful, reliable information. The page stresses that the value of information lies in its truthfulness; misleading or fake communications damage credibility and stakeholder trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loyalität
rubrics_metrics.description: Loyalität is included in the list of central norms of the Kommunikationskodex.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Loyalty refers to professional loyalty obligations within PR practice (to clients/organisations and to the profession’s ethical standards). The page frames PR professionals as interest representatives who nevertheless must follow general guidelines beyond personal values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professionalität
rubrics_metrics.description: Professionalität is named among the Kodex’s core norms and target values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Professionalism includes competence, adherence to professional standards and ensuring the quality and level of the communication service. The page argues professional standards secure the quality and reputation of the entire sector.

rubrics_metrics.name: Absenderklarheit (clarity of sender)
rubrics_metrics.description: The requirement that the responsible agency or company be clearly identifiable as the sender is emphasised (absence of which in 'Tramp a Benz' constituted a violation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit identification of who is behind a communication or campaign (agency, client, sponsor) is required. Anti-pattern: covertly placing messages without sender attribution (hidden sponsorship) — leads to loss of trust and possible formal reprimand by DRPR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vermeidung verdeckter PR / Astroturfing (no covert PR)
rubrics_metrics.description: The page criticises 'verdeckte PR', guerilla/undercover actions and astroturfing as rule violations that endanger credibility.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covert PR tactics (blogger placements without disclosure, fake independent endorsements) are condemned. The page argues such tactics risk the credibility of communications and the sender; transparent, openly branded approaches are preferable and professionally acceptable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kohärenz mit internationalen Standards (consistency/coherence)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Kodex expects actors who commit to international standards to behave coherently and consistently with those standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an organisation claims to adhere to international PR standards, consistent observance across activities is expected. Incoherent application (observing standards sometimes but not others) damages reliability and trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verantwortung für Reputation / Professionsethik (professional responsibility & self-regulation)
rubrics_metrics.description: PR and communications professionals bear responsibility for the reputation and reputation management of the organisations they serve; professions need ethical norms beyond legal rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legal norms are insufficient for all professional conduct; a profession requires ethical self-regulation (Professionsethiken). Practitioners should follow common guidelines to decide what is professionally allowed and what is not, because individual values alone are inadequate for public trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Auf praktische Umsetzbarkeit achten (practical implementability)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Kodex is intended to provide concrete help for practical implementation, including guidance relevant to new developments like social media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond abstract principles, the code aims to offer actionable guidance and concrete examples to help communicators implement ethics in practice (e.g., how to handle social media, disclosures, and new communication formats). The interview cited criticised older codes for not offering such practical help.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertrauensaufbau (building and maintaining trust)
rubrics_metrics.description: A normative goal of professional PR is to establish and maintain trust between companies and stakeholders; rule violations damage this trust.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should be designed to create and preserve stakeholder trust; deceptive or covert practices undermine the communicative and economic foundations of trust and thus are to be avoided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Beachtung von Branchenselbstkontrolle und Dialog (engage with self-regulatory bodies and public discussion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The development process and events emphasise discussion with the public and organs of self-control in advertising and journalism before finalising the code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards should be developed and applied in cooperation with industry self-regulatory bodies and through public discourse; practitioners are expected to engage in these processes and respect rulings from self-regulatory organs.
